chronology.finding: Later Kentucky approval superseded the earlier schedule.

FTA withdrew the EEO Circular guidance and states the withdrawal eliminates the Circular-based EEO program plan/document submission and FTA review burden, without changing underlying nondiscrimination obligations.

resolution: The January 2022 email reminder matched the 2018 approval schedule.
The 2020 Kentucky approval reset the next historical due date to January 30, 2024.
The archive contains a plan updated through June 30, 2024, but no corresponding 2024 approval/response letter has been found.
FTA withdrew Circular 4704.1A effective June 5, 2026, so the old federal recurring EEO Program reporting/submission cycle must not be treated as current by default.
RTEC's August 26, 2026 signed EEO policy is current internal policy evidence; Kentucky's post-withdrawal subrecipient documentation expectation remains to be clarified.
